policies.lead: We are all humans and things happen — I understand. Here is how booking works.

items.title: Deposit
items.q: Do I need a deposit to book?
items.text: A {deposit}% deposit is required to secure your session — no deposit, no session secured. The deposit is non-refundable.

items.title: Cancelling
items.q: How much notice do I need to cancel?
items.text: Please let me know at least {hours} hours before your session.

items.title: Rescheduling
items.text: Your {deposit}% deposit is applied to the rescheduled session — once. If the rescheduled session is canceled, you’ll need to book a new session.

items.title: Running late
items.text: There’s a {minutes}-minute grace period. After that it counts as a no-show and the deposit can’t be applied to another session. Please message me as soon as you can.

items.title: Getting your photos
items.q: When should I book to get my photos in time?
items.text: Book with enough time to get your photos back by the date you need them. Every photo is delivered edited, in a private online gallery.

items.title: Minors
items.text: Sessions for anyone under {age} need a parent or guardian’s consent.

items.title: Payments
items.text: Payments are made directly to {owner} (for example Zelle, Cash App or cash) and recorded by hand. This website never asks for card details.

items.title: Sharing your photos
items.q: Will my photos be posted online?
items.text: Only with your permission. When you book you can say whether your photos may be shared on {brand}’s social media and website, and anything you don’t want posted (for example, kids’ faces).

privacy.intro: This policy explains what information {legal} (“we”) collects through this website, the client portal and bookings, and how it is used. We keep it short and we don’t sell your data.

sections.title: What we collect
items: Contact details you send us: name, email, phone number and the details of the session you want.
Booking information: session type, date, location, notes, and whether your photos may be shared.
Client accounts: your sign-in email or phone and a securely hashed password.
Your photos, stored privately on our own server for the time your gallery is open.

sections.title: How we use it
items: To answer you, confirm and run your session, and deliver your gallery.
To send emails about your booking and gallery (for example, a reminder before your gallery closes).
We never sell or rent your information, and we don’t use advertising trackers.

sections.title: Cookies
items: Signing in sets one secure, http-only session cookie that keeps you logged in. It is not used for tracking.
Your language choice is remembered in your browser so the site opens in the language you picked.

sections.title: Your photos and galleries
items: Galleries are private: only you (with your sign-in or the gallery password) and {owner} can see them.
Photos are deleted when your gallery expires; we email you before that happens so you can download them.
We only post your photos publicly if you gave permission when booking.

sections.title: Your choices
items: You can ask for a copy of your information, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it by writing to {email}.
Some records (like payments) may be kept as long as the law requires.

sections.title: Children
items: Sessions for anyone under {age} need a parent or guardian’s consent, and the booking is made by the adult.

sections.title: Contact
items: Questions about this policy: {email}.

terms.intro: By using this website or a client gallery you agree to these terms.

sections.title: Bookings
items: Sending a request does not reserve a date: {owner} confirms every booking by hand, and the session is secured once the deposit is received.
Prices on this site are starting prices; a location fee or added services can change the total.
The booking policies are part of these terms.

sections.title: Photographs and copyright
items: All photographs on this site and in client galleries are © {legal}. Copyright stays with {legal}.
Clients receive a personal-use license for their own gallery: print and share them with friends and family, and post them on your social media with credit (@{instagram}).
Commercial use, editing or applying filters to the delivered photos, or selling them, needs written permission. Branding sessions include use for your own business.

sections.title: Client accounts and galleries
items: Keep your sign-in and gallery password private. Galleries are available for a limited time; download your photos before they expire.

sections.title: The website
items: The content of this site may not be copied or reused without permission. We may update these terms; the date above shows the latest version.
